payload.text: The tap's CI on 434d105, run 43922068740, attempt 2 (https://github.com/matthewsinclair/homebrew-ccusage/actions/runs/43922068740): the macOS job alone, re-run on vc's word at 18:04Z after attempt 1's macos-15 got no runner; ubuntu-22.04 was green in attempt 1. If GitHub cancels it again for want of a runner, dc tries once more after about half an hour, then leaves it on a hold for after the live repair. dc reports the macOS result to vc's inbox and live; on green vc lands b3ca1c1 from dc/tap-ci-docs; on red dc sends the failing step's output and changes nothing more on the tap.
